procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The Race Committee was represented by Fabian Bach.
facts: After coming back ashore after racing on 23 June 2025, GER 222907 tried signing in using the wristband provided by the Organiser. The sign in was unsuccessful.
Shortly after GER 222907 went to the Race Office to inform that the wristband did not work.
At the Race Office GER 222907 was given a new wristband.
GER 222907 checked the results before the Protest Time Limit expired (13:26) and at that time the results did not display the Standard Penalties.
Standard Penalties applied on 23 June 2025 were posted in notice No. 43 at 17:01 on 23 June 2025.
GER 222907 did not check the notice board at any point.
GER 222907 lodged the request for redress at 10:39 on 24 June 2025.
conclusions: GER 222907 failed to deliver the request for redress as soon as reasonably possible after the relevant information was available, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(3).
